disclosed: 55 of 68 declared quiet dependents pass the mechanical check (no changed name, suite green) but can be reached by searching the request's own words, usually through ordinary docstrings or docs prose. They were kept: making them quieter would mean hiding, which the design forbids. Also disclosed: every expected fact is graded at every stage, so an agent that extends a documented list beyond what its request asks would be graded stale on that row; and the name check reads changed docstring lines word by word, so some authors kept old docstring wording.
